name: Pottery Neolithic Levant
alt: Early Chalcolithic of the Southern Levant

successors.name: Ghassulian
successors.text: the "Southern Levant" of the Wadi Rabah culture: Wadi Rabah, Dan, Sepphoris, Yizre'el, Tel Yosef, Ein el-Jarba, Munhata, Lod, Tell es-Sultan (Jericho), Atlit Yam, Teluliot Batashi

ledger.x: 6000 BCE: the Yarmukian villages of the Jordan valley, the first potters of the Levant, open the map.
5500 BCE: the Wadi Rabah culture replaces the Yarmukian-Lodian Pottery Neolithic.
4400 BCE: the Ghassulian Chalcolithic succeeds the Wadi Rabah.

certainty.note: An archaeological culture: a band along the Jordan and radii around excavated sites, never a frontier.
